actual_outcome.implementation_notes: Added Avatar to single-assistant branch (lines 117-136). Applied optional chaining (assistantData?.[0]) and added !currentChat?.isGroup guard to prevent double-rendering in 1-member group chats. Added 3 unit tests: avatar with icon, without icon, click handler. All 4 quality gates pass (lint, typecheck, 4171 unit tests, 468 integration tests).
